lead: Each subject is a topic. Whoever opened it, or the moderators, mark when it is resolved.
entrarParaAbrir: To open a topic, join the community.

regra.ultima: A topic moves up when someone replies. The rule is the same for everyone: no reactions, reach or profile count.
regra.novos: From the most recently opened topic to the oldest, the same for everyone.
regra.sem_resposta: Only topics still waiting for their first reply, newest first.

regra.encaminhado: Became a lesson, wiki page or task.
regra.resolvido: The question was answered or the subject is closed.

item.novasRegra: Replies since your last visit. How far you have read is kept only on this device.

resumo.dica: Up to 140 characters, on a single line. It shows at the top of the topic and in the forum list.

topico.regraMudar: Whoever opened the topic, or the moderators, change the status and the summary.
topico.verOriginal: See the conversation it came from

virar.lead: Opens a new forum topic quoting this message. The original conversation stays where it is, marked with where it continues.
virar.avisoAutora: This message is not yours: its author gets a notice that it was taken to the forum.
virar.semComunidade: You are not yet in any community where you can open a topic.
virar.corpoPadrao: This subject started in a conversation and continues here, so it does not get lost.
virar.avaliar: The topic will wait for the moderators to read it before it shows.

novo.avaliar: The topic will wait for the moderators to read it before it shows.

novas.barra: {n} new replies since your last visit
novas.uma: 1 new reply since your last visit
novas.pular: Jump to the first new one
novas.regra: How far you have read is kept only on this device.

vazio.todos: No topics yet. How about opening the first one?

erros.ja_virou: This message has already become a topic in that community.
erros.invalido:topico: This conversation is not a forum topic.
erros.invalido:resumo: The summary could not be saved: please review the text.
erros.invalido:titulo: The title must be 5 to 140 characters long.
erros.invalido:corpo: The message must be at least 10 characters long.
erros.invalido:flair: That tag does not exist in this community.
